data.name: Jithu
data.gender_notes: Jithu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jithu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jita', meaning 'victory' or 'success'. It is a name of great significance in Hindu culture, often given to children as a symbol of hope and triumph. The name is also associated with the god Vishnu, who is known for his power to grant victory and prosperity. The name Jithu carries the meaning “Victory, Success” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jithu usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May the blessings of Lord Vishnu bring you victory and success in all your endeavors.
data.etymology: Jithu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jithu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jithu holds a profound cultural significance in Hindu society, as it symbolizes power, strength, and success. In Hindu mythology, the deity Vishnu is often represented as the preserver of the universe and the giver of victory. By giving a child the name Jithu, parents bestow upon them the blessings and protection of Vishnu, hoping that they will grow up to be victorious and successful in all their endeavors.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jithu holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism, as it is derived from the root word 'jita', which represents victory over one's inner demons and obstacles. The name serves as a constant reminder to the bearer of the importance of perseverance, determination, and moral integrity. By embodying the qualities of victory and success, the name Jithu serves as a source of inspiration and motivation for the individual to overcome life's challenges and achieve spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jithu: The radiant one, illuminating the path to wisdom and enlightenment. Embodiment of inner strength, wisdom, and joy.
